overview_description.description:
Sunday is a robotics and artificial intelligence company developing Memo, an autonomous home robot designed to assist with everyday household tasks. The company focuses on creating general-purpose home robotics systems that can learn and perform practical chores such as clearing tables, loading dishwashers, handling laundry, organizing household items, and preparing simple beverages. Its mission is to reduce the time people spend on repetitive domestic work by combining advanced robotics hardware with AI-powered learning systems. The company's technology is built around large-scale robotic learning, enabling Memo to acquire new skills through human demonstrations and continuously expand its capabilities over time. A key component of this approach is Sunday’s proprietary Skill Capture Glove, which records human movements and interactions, allowing the robot to learn and replicate real-world tasks. The company uses these demonstrations to train AI models that help the robot operate autonomously in diverse home environments.

Unlike traditional task-specific robots, Sunday is developing a platform intended to support a growing library of household skills. Its AI systems are designed to generalize across different homes, layouts, and object configurations, enabling the robot to perform tasks in environments it has never previously encountered. The company emphasizes autonomous operation, safety, and privacy by training its models using externally collected data rather than relying on teleoperation inside customer homes. In addition to robotics hardware, Sunday develops the underlying AI, computer vision, manipulation, and machine learning technologies that enable perception, navigation, and task execution. The company is currently preparing a beta program for early adopters while continuing to expand the robot’s capabilities and reliability through ongoing research and development.
